funding_routes.name: Working Capital
funding_routes.description: Optimized for established businesses needing growth capital for day-to-day operations, payroll, or expansion.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Standard business checking with revenue above $15k/mo and 1+ years in business.
advantages: Funds available in as little as 48 hours
High approval rates for healthy cash flow

funding_routes.name: Real Estate Funding
funding_routes.description: Specialized bridge and term loans for fix-and-flip, rental acquisitions, or commercial portfolio expansion.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Primary purpose identified as Real Estate Investment.
advantages: Financing based on property value, not personal income

funding_routes.name: Equipment Financing
funding_routes.description: Low-rate financing specifically for hardware, machinery, vehicles, or specialized software implementations.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Primary purpose identified as Equipment or Vehicles.
advantages: The equipment acts as the collateral

funding_routes.name: E-commerce Funding
funding_routes.description: Revenue-based financing designed specifically for the digital lifecycle of high-volume online sellers.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Industry identified as E-commerce or primary purpose is Inventory.
advantages: Repayment scales with your sales volume
No fixed monthly payments during slow seasons

funding_routes.name: Quick Micro-Funding
funding_routes.description: High-speed, lower-barrier capital designed for gig workers, solo-preneurs, and businesses using personal accounts.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Personal/Gig banking handle or Revenue under $5,000/mo.
advantages: Lowest documentation requirements in the industry

funding_routes.name: Business Credit Prep
funding_routes.description: A structured path to address credit or documentation gaps to reach 'funding-ready' status in 60-90 days.
funding_routes.match_criteria: Credit score below 580 or inability to provide bank statements.

program_specs.focus_areas: Credit Repair, Entity Cleanup, Trade-line Building

advantages: Stops credit declines before they happen
Builds a separate credit profile for the EIN
Positions business for prime bank rates
